title: First plan for dad
author: Wyatt Blower
desc: Introducing the "First Plan for Dad," a focused 2-week workout program designed to help busy fathers get back into fitness with ease. Committing to 6 days a week, you'll engage in a variety of machine-based exercises targeting major muscle groups, including chest, legs, and back. Each session is structured to maximize efficiency, featuring clear video tutorials to guide you through proper form. Get ready to build strength and confidence while balancing your family life!
